description: Mercatura's shielded ETH pool on Robinhood Chain (0xbow's Privacy Pools v1 plus Mercatura's deposit gate; it uses an association set): whether it is live and, if not, what is not yet; whether deposits are open; the approved deposits in the association set, which is what a payment hides among; the minimum and per-deposit cap; the relayer (online, fee); the contracts; the screening rules; and what the chain shows and hides. The same answer as GET /v1/shielded. Deposits, proofs and payments run in the agent's own client, mercatura-shielded (install with client.install), never on Mercatura's servers: the note secret is the money.
name: shielded_status
title: Shielded payments: status
